_doc: Kinds of crime (T-0091, docs/design/crime-and-police.md). severity 1-8 sets police priority and punishment. An interaction commits one with "crime": "<id>"; each crime committed is saved as an incident. Only shoplifting has an interaction so far. witness (T-0092): people see a crime within day_range cells (night_range from night_from to night_until o'clock) on the same floor, awake, with nothing that blocks sight in between; each remembers it (saw_crime, memory_valence, memory_salience). police (T-0093): each witness reports with chance report_base + report_per_severity x severity (max 0.95), x friend_report_factor if their friendship with the perpetrator is >= friend_at; reported crimes count towards the wanted level for heat_hours game hours: level = ceil(sum of severities / severity_per_level), max 5.
